Engineered for ultimate performance, this powerful device transmits stunning HDMI video and crystal‑clear audio over distances up to 328 feet (100 meters) using a single RG‑6 coaxial cable. This means you can often utilize pre‑existing coaxial infrastructure in homes or commercial spaces, simplifying installation and reducing the need for costly new wiring. No more compromises‑enjoy the full brilliance of 4K resolution at 60Hz (4:4:4), accompanied by immersive audio up to 5.1 channels, with support for Dolby Digital® and DTS® formats.Designed with versatility and ease‑of‑use in mind, the Blackbird 4K60 Video Extender offers advanced audio embedding and de‑embedding, so you can tailor your audio experience to any environment. Whether you're integrating with a control system using bi‑directional IR pass‑through or taking advantage of sophisticated EDID® management for seamless device compatibility, installation and operation are effortless. The wall‑mountable metal enclosure adds durability and a polished, professional finish to any installation.Enjoy future‑ready capabilities including HDR, HDR10+, Dolby Vision™, HLG, and full HDCP™ 2.2 compliance. With flexible control options, a complete set of included accessories, and reliable long‑distance transmission, the Blackbird by Monoprice 4K60 Video Extender redefines AV distribution.
